evals.prompt: Add an admin endpoint to change a customer's transfer limit.
evals.expected_output: Writes an audit event in the same transaction with actor, before, after, reason code and request id; the table is append-only; a test asserts the event.
expectations: The audit event is written in the same transaction as the limit change
Event includes actor, before and after values, reason and request id
A reason code is required from the admin UI or API
A test asserts exactly one event with the required fields after the change

evals.prompt: Our AI agent now approves refunds under $50 automatically. Make sure we can explain each one.
evals.expected_output: Records actor_type agent with on_behalf_of and the policy or run id, keeps approval separate from execution, makes events queryable per customer, and tests it.
expectations: Events record actor_type agent and on whose behalf, plus the policy or run that authorized the action
Approval and execution are separate events
Events are queryable by customer and by actor
Tests assert the agent fields on the event

evals.prompt: An auditor asks who changed our fee schedule in Q3 and why.
evals.expected_output: Queries the audit trail by object and time and exports it in the documented format; if no trail exists, plans same-transaction events and says debug logs are not sufficient.
expectations: Answers from an append-only audit record, not application logs
Provides the export in a stable, documented format
If the trail is missing, proposes same-transaction audit events going forward
